command_block:
export PATH=/opt/data/bin:/opt/data/opt/go/bin:$PATH
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path("internal/configs/state_migrate_file.go")
s = p.read_text()
old = "\tRequirement map[addrs.Provider]providerreqs.VersionConstraints\n"
new = "\tRequirement providerreqs.Requirements\n"
assert s.count(old) == 1
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new))
PY
gofmt -w internal/configs/state_migrate_file.go
go test ./internal/configs -run '^(TestParserLoadConfigDirWithStateMigrations_from_state_store|TestBaselineV3StateStoreRequirementNamedType)$'
